featured_reviews.name: Shobhana Nair
featured_reviews.review_text: They are the best. We were living abroad when the wedding planning was being done and also we had very limited time during our India visit for the wedding. So all our research and interactions were done via internet/phone/email. When it came to printing the wedding cards, there aren't too many of them with a website and also we were very skeptical to not physically see the quality of cards before picking up one. We were referred to Niarika Arts and that was such a blessing. We sent a mail out to Janak from Niarika and he guided us with the process. In 4 days since I first emailed Janak, we got the wedding cards couriered. It was that simple and that quick. In the first couple of days, we sent them our design and selected the catalog number, did a fund transfer, got the soft copy of sample card in email for approval. The day after approval, the cards were couriered and by the 4th day we had the cards! The cards were so beautiful and had such a classy finish. Janak Ghadiali and the Niarika team were very polite and prompt with the email and phone response and they delivered quality at reasonable price. We highly recommend them.

We regret that you had such experience...According to our knowledge your staff has asked for multiple quotations in which it included 1 - Map Lamination , 2 - Map Mounting On 5mm Sunboard , 3 - Multiple Prints of Same Map...As we have a retail counter we have alot of people walking in so it is not possible to remember oral quotations given..We also told your staff to take a written quotation on which he said HE WAS IN A HURRY AND WILL GET BACK TO US & SAID HE UNDERSTOOD THE PRICE RANGE..We have alot of daily enquires so that is the reason when you called on Landline Our Owner told you say us the size of MAP so we can understand and match the quote given earlier , the reason to ask the SIZE OF MAP was because had same kind of enquire we had from other customer as well...On asking this question the person on the call started Yelling & Shouting & said that why are you giving different quotes on which we again explained please mention the size we can work it out..But their was no positive reply but just Shouting..

As you mentioned earlier that you get your work done from us since last many year you could have trusted us !! That for 200rs no shopkeeper will spoil customer relations..It was not a huge amount sir for which we as a shopkeeper will argue or behave rude with our customer..Above all this if you felt we were rude to you...We are sorry for the inconvenience caused...I hope you give another chance to serve you again based the earlier works we have done for you and the work relations we have had with you for years..

description:
We are a digital print house located at Khadilkar road, Girgaon.
We specialise in foil printing without using traditional dyes which save cost and turnaround time . With in house digital cutting and finishing, we can finish jobs faster with superior quality.
With over 15 years experience in the field of digital printing, we cater to various clients in the entertainment and corporate world.
It would be our pleasure to serve your print needs as best as we can.
Please feel free to call or visit for any enquiry.
address: Shop No, Shanti Building, 2, Khadilkar Rd, Charni Road East, Ambewadi, Girgaon, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400004

featured_reviews.name: ShreyaShetty Official
featured_reviews.review_text: Absolutely love their work I have been working with them from a very long time but due to Covid I was not in touch with Ashish but now I have started my own small business and he created this amazing piece for me within just couple of days. Hats off to the whole team. Just lost their work and I would recommend them to everyone.

featured_reviews.name: jolanda gonsalves
featured_reviews.review_text: I’ve got a whole bunch of stuff made from Krisstech, right from my wedding invites to business cards, letterheads, paper bags, garment tags, stickers, bill books etc and they have always delivered the best quality of products. Krisstech is my go to place for all my printing needs and Ashish is always helpful and a breeze to work with. If you want exceptional quality and service, Krisstech is your answer! I highly recommend them.

featured_reviews.name: Lydia
featured_reviews.review_text: I like to be different, unique and be myself. I like items that reflect my personality. This is one place where I have personalised many items from coasters / table mats / deco to stationary items all according to my whims and fancies. Everything that is done here fascinates me.

featured_reviews.name: B Jane
featured_reviews.review_text: Great service. Their print quality and product finishing is very excellent. Will surely recommend if you want to get your work done from here.
